notes.title: Introducing ASUKA!
notes.content: [p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313373/2526a3ed29b780df0b4ec9cbb365d76a31426a35.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]We’re thrilled to announce a new name and an upgraded character model for our game![/b][/p][p]Say hello to ASUKA x Redline Reverie, a title inspired by one of ASUKA's quirks: her fascination with a few things French! This theme is deeply woven into her character arc, and we can’t wait to show you how it unfolds through rich, story-driven gameplay.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313373/2fc1d4a8a111a766b7dac85c4cda014a206c83bb.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks to your wonderful support early on, we’ve gained the confidence to invest even more into the project. That means a bigger art budget, a remodeled ASUKA, and a stronger focus on expressive, story-rich visuals. These changes have been made possible because of your interest in the project. Every follower counts![/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="Je5d1-_m-E4;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]We’ll be sharing regular art drops and story previews on Twitter so you can get to know ASUKA, her friends and her rivals well before release. As a single-player narrative experience, we believe strong characters make all the difference.[/p][p][/p][p]This is just the beginning.[/p][p][b]Thank you for showing your support![/b][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/cZJj8pYPaN"]JION OUR DISCORD[/url] [/p]
